name: Collapsing Porch
description: A section of splintery and rotten floorboards drop a creature 6 feet onto uneven rocks and piercing shards of wood.
disable: DC 15 Crafting check (trained) to replace or cover the weak sections of flooring, or DC 15 Survival check (trained) to crumble the rotten floorboards from a safe distance
reset: Once this section of the porch has collapsed, creatures can still fall through the hole until the porch is Repaired.

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description: If a creature walks on the area marked on the map, it falls through the weakened floorboards onto uneven rocks and sharp shards of wood, taking 1d4 piercing damage and 1d6 bludgeoning damage. The creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid the fall and the damage.
